Introduction

ARISE is an upcoming four-member girl group under BY-U Entertainment. They are set make their debut in 2025. They will release their first pre-debut single album "READY TO START" on August 8, 2025.

Their group name means to wake up, rise, and transform from the girl crush concept to a refreshing and bright atmosphere that can give a sense of beginning, change and idol growth.
